title: Dimetric stipple loggia

reference.grammar: flat four-ink façade fragment, black brush contour, black spatter stipple for shading, near-frontal dimetric construction

axes_deg.method: structure-tensor orientation histogram of dark edges at 540 px: peaks at 10–15° (down-right) and 145–150° (up-right 30°)

ground.colour: none: the picture is edge-to-edge fills, and the blue wall (#D2F1F3) acts as ground

units: design units, 1000 = plate width, frame 1000 × 1666; scene units × 0.85 (1 u = 0.54 ref px at 540, 1.2 px at 1200)

techniques.name: Brush-ink contour

params.join_swell: ×(1 + 0.35·(1 − d/12 u)) within 12 u of a corner > 23°
params.taper: open lines: soft (to 55 % over min(14 u, 25 %)); flutes, spirals, bars: full taper to 0 over min(30 u, 30 %), exponent 0.6

techniques.implementation: Every edge is resampled at 7 u, displaced along its normal by a 3-octave sine noise (0.9 u), then filled as a variable-width ribbon (outer + inner offset polylines, even-odd) whose width = base·(1+0.22·noise)·taper·(1+0.5·max(0,−n·light))·(1+0.35·cornerProximity), so edges facing down-left and every corner run heavier; the ink layer under every later face is erased (destination-out) so occluded lines vanish.

techniques.name: Fluted-shaft stipple

params.coverage: λ = 0.62·d + 4·max(0,d−0.75)² expected black area per px, dots placed as a Poisson process p = λ / mean dot area
params.modulation: value noise on an 8 u grid, ×(0.75 … 1.25)
params.crisp: plate-pixel coverage a → smoothstep((a − 0.16)/0.30): a dot covering ≥ 46 % of a plate pixel prints solid, matching the reference’s hard 1-px dots
params.shaft_ramp: 0.34·(1−u)^3 across the apparent width (u = 0 at the shadow/left edge) + 0.14 rim at u > 0.7
params.flute_sawtooth: 10 flutes between 9 lines at k = −0.8 … 0.8 of the half-width; each flute 0.34·(1−0.8·t)·(1−v)^2.6, v = 0 at its left line, t = 0 at the shadow side
params.neck_bands: 0.3 → 0 over 38 u under the astragal, 0.15 → 0 over 30 u above the base

capital.volute_block: rounded slab in the shaft-front plane, Z 1180…1240, half-width hw + 30, end radius 25, 0.4 → 0 band at the shadow end, two 1.75-turn spirals 4.5 u tapered, two 3.6 u fillets

params.mask: density painted inside the face clip only
params.supersample: work canvas scaled so a dot is ≥ 2.6 px, then box-filtered down

techniques.implementation: The shaft is filled blue and a horizontal gray gradient plus ten per-flute sawtooth gradients are painted into the density map inside the shaft clip; the global pass reads the map (upscaled so dots stay ≥ 2.6 px), keeps each work pixel with probability λ/dotArea and stamps an anti-aliased disc, then the dot layer is box-filtered to the plate, crisped with a smoothstep on coverage and composited as black.

techniques.name: Half-lit front field

on: +X faces of every box (blue and yellow)
params.pier_corner: 0.25 → 0 over 40 u beside the return edge
params.column_halo: 0.4 → 0 over 48 u on the shadow side, 0.25 → 0 over 30 u lit side
params.under_cornice: 0.4 → 0 over 34 u on the frieze, 0.25 → 0 over 16 u on the architrave
params.ashlar: courses every 70 (4.2 u), staggered joints every 150

techniques.implementation: Half-lit faces get a uniform 0.10–0.11 in the density map; additive (lighter) gradient bands are laid from 3-D edges with bandE(), which takes the edge and an into-face direction and builds the band perpendicular to the projected edge so its iso-lines stay parallel to the edge.

techniques.name: Flat ink face

params.assignment: blue = wall, fronts of piers/base/architrave/frieze, shafts, capitals, plinths, risers, relief-panel field; yellow = every top, every right-hand return (−Y) face, cornice, dentil row, string course, sills, lintels, jambs, rails, newel, medallion ring, reveals; pink = floor, balusters; red = shutters and door

door.leaf: red, X = −40, 2 × 3 panels, 0.4 band inside each panel

techniques.implementation: Each face is a closed polygon filled with one of the four hexes; the ink layer under it is erased so occluded lines vanish, then the face paints its own density before its own detail lines are drawn.

techniques.name: Stippled yellow return

params.front_edge_band: 0.42 → 0 over min(70 u, half the face width), pow 1.3
params.top_band: 0.25 → 0 over min(40 u, 40 % of the height)
params.course_bands: 0.3 → 0 over 12 u under every pier course (60 u pitch)
params.on: every −Y (right-facing) return: both piers, step returns, rail and newel ends, jamb/lintel/sill ends, shutter edges (red, 0.2)

techniques.implementation: box() resolves a {ret:true} face spec into the yellow fill plus a uniform 0.14 and three additive edge bands laid with bandE() from the face’s own 3-D edges, so the spatter is densest against the contour and thins toward the middle of the face.

techniques.name: Near-frontal dimetric

params.type: parallel dimetric, verticals vertical (not the 30°/30° isometric the AD assumed; the pixels disagree)

axes_deg.Y_facade: −12 (runs left along the façade, rising 12°; a façade horizontal falls 12° to the right)
axes_deg.X_depth: +30 (toward the viewer, down-left at 30°; the receding depth rises 30° to the right)

visible_faces: return (−Y, the right-hand side of every mass)
params.circles: horizontal circle → tilted ellipse: apparent half-width 1.199 r, semi-minor 0.451 r, left tangent at circle angle atan2(cos12°, cos30°·0.8) = 54.7°
params.measured: reference orientation peaks at 10–15° (façade horizontals, down-right) and 145–150° (depth, up-right 30°) on the floor, balustrade, slab and base; the upper façade drifts toward horizontal by hand (5–20°); foreshortening 0.8 estimated from the floor tiles

scene.base: Z −800…150 with arch r 120/162 at Y 480

techniques.implementation: One iso(X,Y,Z) maps every point; boxes are three parallelograms (top, +X front, −Y return) drawn back to front, then a hexagonal silhouette contour and three inner edges from the interior vertex (X1, Y0, Z1); cylinders are the projected front arc at the base, two vertical tangents at ±1.199 r and the projected back arc at the top.

techniques.name: Four-ink color system

params.rule: black stipple over any ink where the face is shaded or half-lit; only tops and the clean trims stay pure

medallion.ring: #FFFF01 oval rY 52 / rZ 64 in the frieze plane (X = 220), 6.5 u contour + 3.6 u inner line
medallion.hands: tapered black ribbons 6→0 (27 u) and 5→0 (37 u), hub r 4

techniques.implementation: No mixed colors anywhere; every midtone in the picture is black dots over a flat ink, so the color histogram stays five-peaked.

techniques.name: Turned baluster

params.half_widths: top 11, neck 7 @0.12, belly 17 @0.58, waist 8 @0.85, foot 12 (×1.199 apparent)
params.rails: Z 200…236 and 350…380, yellow, 4.2 u molding line, returns stippled
params.newel: 50 × 40 × 200 with a 60 × 50 × 20 cap, 3.6 u panel line

techniques.implementation: A vase profile r(t) (smoothstep between knots) is mirrored into a closed polygon about the axis’ projected x, filled pink with a left-heavy horizontal density ramp; the pink floor behind the row carries a cast band.

techniques.name: Pink tile floor

params.set_x: lines along X every 60 units (30° family)
params.wall_shadow: 0.25 over 26 u along the wall base
params.slab_edge: yellow +X band Z 150…200 with 4.2 u and 3.6 u molding lines, 0.10 field

techniques.implementation: The slab top is filled pink, then two families of axis lines are ribbon-stroked with the ink clipped to the face polygon; later faces erase what they cover.

techniques.name: Rusticated base

params.pier_grid: courses every 60, blocks 160 (front) / 100 (return), staggered, 4.2 u, on both visible pier faces
params.wall_ashlar: courses every 70, 4.2 u, joints staggered every 150
params.dentils: solid ink gaps 12 × 19 u every 30 u under the cornice

techniques.implementation: Course joints and staggered verticals are ribbon lines (5 u) doubled by a 3.6 u bevel line over a sparse blue face; under each course a gradient band in the density map makes the stipple read as a chamfer; the arch is an annulus sector of yellow with radial joints over a dark stippled recess.

pass_order: faces back-to-front (wall + ashlar, loggia window + shutters, door, string course + relief panel, base + arch, slab/floor, columns, balustrade + newel, piers, entablature + medallion + dentils, steps); each fills color, erases ink beneath, paints density inside its own clip, draws its own detail lines
density map → per-pixel Poisson spatter on a supersampled work canvas (dot ≥ 2.6 px)
dot layer box-filtered to the plate, crisped, composited as black
ink layer (contours, fluting, joints, dentils, moldings, spirals, hands) composited last
notes: Reference measured at 540 px wide: mortar 2 px (3.7 u), contours 4–5 px (7–9 u), swell to 8 px, stipple dots 1 px, black area 0.372, line share at 96 px 0.357.

Pass 3 rebuild: projection re-measured (façade −12°, depth +30°, ×0.8; not true isometric); every right-hand return is yellow under spatter; fronts 0.10; fluting 9 lines + per-flute sawtooth; Ionic volute capitals; dentils, fasciae, string course, relief panel; ashlar on every masonry face; join swell + soft taper on contours; dot layer crisped so spatter prints as hard dots.
Rebuild measured the same way: black area 0.39, line share at 96 px 0.30.
Line widths scale with the plate: at 700 css px @ dpr 2 a 4.5 u detail line is 6.3 px, a dot 3.6 px.
